verdict.rationale: Admin SDK Directory/Reports APIs support paginated bulk retrieval of users and audit data, and Apps Script lets users automate many admin console tasks at once (google-workspace-docs-5, -6, -14, -22, -24), which are real bulk-operation mechanisms. However, evidence is limited to admin/directory-level bulk actions and never shows bulk operations on everyday content (Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Drive files) or any AI-native/agent-driven bulk workflow. Missing for 10: evidence of bulk actions on user-facing content (mass edit/move/organize files, bulk email processing), AI-agent-specific bulk tooling, and independent/hands-on confirmation of these bulk capabilities working at scale.
